items.title: SWE Intern
items.description: Delivered 3 enterprise-scale projects across healthcare, fintech, and enterprise AI — including an LLM-powered anomaly detection system for healthcare claims, a full-stack CMS price transparency platform, and a multi-agent enterprise RAG chatbot.
highlights: Health & Insurance Proxy Modelling — Built an LLM-powered anomaly detection system for healthcare claims, reducing settlement delays. Processed 50+ claims with 72.25% accuracy in flagging anomalies.
CMS Price Transparency Platform — Developed a full-stack platform processing 1,000+ hospital datasets, reducing ETL time.
Enterprise Agentic RAG Chatbot — Designed a multi-agent RAG system with 85% faster retrieval and 98% precision. Adopted by 2 internal teams within the company.
Built 10+ reusable AI modules, accelerating feature development by 50% across teams.
